examples.sentence: 我何尝不想买一所大房子呢？
examples.romanization: wǒ hécháng bùxiǎng mǎi yī suǒ dà fángzi ne？
examples.translation: Why wouldn’t I want to buy a big house?

examples.sentence: 你何至于生这么大的气呢？
examples.romanization: nǐ hé zhìyú shēng zhème dà de qì ne？
examples.translation: Why do you have to get so angry?

title: V 了个 RESULT (V to RESULT)
longExplanation: V to RESULT. Pinyin: V le gè RESULT

title: 据说…… (It is said that…)
longExplanation: It is said that…. Pinyin: jùshuō……

examples.sentence: 据说，他年轻时曾经一个人去过非洲大森林。
examples.romanization: jùshuō， tā niánqīng shí céngjīng yīgèrén qù guò Fēizhōu dà sēnlín。
examples.translation: It is said that at one time he went to the great forest in Africa when he was young.

examples.sentence: 这条河河道很窄，因而容易发生水灾。
examples.romanization: zhè tiáo hé hédào hěn zhǎi， yīn'ér róngyì fāshēng shuǐzāi。
examples.translation: The river is narrow and is therefore prone to flooding.

examples.romanization: nǐ bùxiǎng gàn yě dé gàn。
examples.translation: You still have to do it even if you don’t want to.

title: 再……也…… (no matter how)
longExplanation: no matter how. Pinyin: zài…… yě……

examples.sentence: 我再累也要把作业做完。
examples.romanization: wǒ zài lèi yě yào bǎ zuòyè zuòwán。
examples.translation: No matter how tired I am, I need to finish my homework.

title: 巴不得 (be only too eager to)
longExplanation: be only too eager to. Pinyin: bābude

examples.sentence: 我巴不得他们能真的和好，从此以后和和睦睦过日子。
examples.romanization: wǒ bābude tāmen néng zhēn de héhǎo， cóngcǐ yǐhòu hé hémù mù guòrìzi。
examples.translation: I only wish that they could really be reconciled and lived in harmony from now on.

examples.sentence: 这个人办事，别提多负责了。
examples.romanization: zhège rén bànshì， bié tíduō fùzé le。
examples.translation: This person does things, don't mention more responsibility.

id: zh_具有语体差别的同义词_624
pattern: 具有语体差别的同义词
title: 具有语体差别的同义词 (synonyms that differ by style)
longExplanation: synonyms that differ by style. Pinyin: jùyǒu yǔ tǐ chà biéde tóngyìcí
formation: jùyǒu yǔ tǐ chà biéde tóngyìcí

examples.sentence: 他便/就回答说/道：“将/把这只戒指拿去吧。”
examples.romanization: tā biàn/ jiù huídá shuō/ dào：“ jiāng/ bǎ zhè zhǐ jièzhi ná qù ba。”
examples.translation: Then he just said, “Take this ring.”

examples.sentence: 工作忙的时候，她恨不得一个人干两个人的活儿。
examples.romanization: gōngzuò máng de shíhou， tā hènbude yīgèrén gàn liǎng gèrén de huór。
examples.translation: When the work [gets] busy, she wished [she could] do two people’s work all by herself.

examples.sentence: 听了医生的话，顿时，他的心里又燃起了希望。
examples.romanization: tīng le yīshēng dehuà， dùnshí， tā de xīnli yòu ránqǐ le xīwàng。
examples.translation: After hearing to the doctor's words, suddenly, his heart lit up hope again.

title: 不由得 (can’t help but to)
longExplanation: can’t help but to. Pinyin: bùyóude

examples.sentence: 李朋带病上场参加比赛了，我不由得有些担心。
examples.romanization: lǐ péng dàibìng shàngchǎng cānjiā bǐsài le， wǒ bùyóude yǒuxiē dānxīn。
examples.translation: Li Peng was sick and went to the competition. I couldn't help but worry (somewhat).

title: V # 番 (V’ed # times over)
longExplanation: V’ed # times over. Pinyin: V # fān

examples.sentence: 他打量了我一番，到嘴边的话又不说了。
examples.romanization: tā dǎliang le wǒ yī fān， dào zuǐ biān dehuà yòu bù shuō le。
examples.translation: He sized me up (once over) and swallowed his words. (Lit. [As for] the words that [came] to the edge of his mouth, he [changed his mind] again and didn’t utter them.)

title: 番 ((measure word for tumultuous events))
longExplanation: (measure word for tumultuous events). Pinyin: fān

examples.sentence: 经过了几番风雨，他才懂得人生的价值。
examples.romanization: jīngguò le jǐ fān fēngyǔ， tā cái dǒngde rénshēng de jiàzhí。
examples.translation: Only after a few (times of) setbacks (lit. storms), he understood the value of life.
